topic.title: Other CPU Core Changes with BIOS Impacts

ul.li: Bi-directional PROCHOT is not supported. The processor will proactively use PROCHOT as an input only. BIOS is required to remove the PROCHOT programming from legacy usage.PROCHOT will be renamed as FORCEPR (Force Power Reduction).
xAPIC support is removed. Refer to the xAPIC Deprecation Plan.
Removal of architectural MSR IA32_DEBUG_INTERFACE (C80H). Detect/Report Platform DebugState for Debug Signed BIOS Guard via TPM PCR[7].
PAM region is mapped to DRAM by default. BIOS must program the TOLUD/BHSM/BDSM to 0 in sec phase before CAR/recovery flow.
When TOLUD = 0, PAM region (0xE0000 and 0xF0000) will be mapped to MMIO.
